title: Economic Benefits of Cross-Border Electricity Trade and Domestic Electricity Production in Switzerland
abstract: arXiv:2611.13866v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper assesses the economic benefits of cross-border electricity trade in the context of rising energy prices and geopolitical uncertainty. Switzerland provides a particularly compelling case because of its geographical location and limited integration into the EU electricity market. We first use the Nexus-e framework to simulate the generation capacity and transmission grid expansion required under autarky and free-trade scenarios. Based on these capacity configurations, a fundamental power market model simulates wholesale market outcomes under projected demand and generation conditions for 2040. By jointly accounting for consumer and producer surplus, as well as investments in generation capacity and grid infrastructure, we provide a comprehensive assessment of the welfare effects of cross-border electricity trade, leading to an estimated EUR 1.5 billion gain. translated_title: 瑞士跨境电力贸易与国内电力生产的经济效益
translated_abstract: 本文评估了在能源价格上涨和地缘政治不确定性背景下跨境电力贸易的经济效益。瑞士因其地理位置以及对欧盟电力市场的有限整合而提供了一个特别引人注目的案例。我们首先使用Nexus-e框架模拟了自给自足和自由贸易两种情景下所需的发电容量和输电网络扩建。基于这些容量配置，一个基础电力市场模型模拟了2040年在预测需求和发电条件下的批发市场结果。通过综合考虑消费者剩余和生产者剩余，以及发电容量和电网基础设施的投资，我们对跨境电力贸易的福利效应进行了全面评估，估计可带来约15亿欧元的收益。更具体而言，开放跨境电力贸易准入意味着……
tldr: 本文通过模拟瑞士2040年自给自足与自由贸易情景下的电力市场，综合评估福利效应后发现跨境电力贸易相比能源自给自足可带来约15亿欧元的经济收益。
en_tdlr: This paper estimates that cross-border electricity trade in Switzerland yields approximately EUR 1.5 billion in welfare gains compared to energy autarky, based on simulated power market outcomes for 2040.
